stories.title: Alunni stranieri, in una classe su 13 si supera il limite del 30%

en.title: Foreign students, in 1 class out of 13 the 30% limit is exceeded
en.summary: The Meloni government announced plans to enforce a binding cap of 30% non-Italian citizens per classroom, bringing attention to classroom composition across schools.

stories.title: Scuola, pronto il decreto sul tetto di alunni stranieri. Ma riguarda 2000 classi

en.title: School, decree on foreign student cap ready. But it affects 2000 classes
en.summary: A government decree on limiting non-Italian students is being prepared, though recent data shows only 0.6% of classrooms exceeded the 30% threshold in the last available school year.

stories.title: Lega, via al congresso e Salvini sfida i ribelli. Fontana: vuoi blindarti

en.title: Lega, congress underway and Salvini challenges rebels. Fontana: do you want to secure yourself?
en.summary: Internal tensions emerged at the Lega party meeting as northern members disputed procedural rules, with the deputy premier indicating he expects an internal challenge to his leadership.

stories.title: Guerra Ucraina – Russia, le news di oggi. Macron: “Colloquio costruttivo con Trump per aiutare Kiev”

en.title: Ukraine war – Russia, today's news. Macron: "Constructive talks with Trump to help Kyiv"
en.summary: Zelensky met with the CIA director, and the EU delayed agreement on renewing individual sanctions against Russia as international diplomatic efforts continue regarding the conflict.

stories.title: Limite agli stranieri in classe, Meloni tira dritto: misure in vigore dall’anno in corso

en.title: Limit on foreign students in class, Meloni pushes forward: measures in force from current school year
en.summary: Italy's government has approved a decree implementing restrictions on foreign students in classrooms. The regulation currently applies to foreign students who arrive after classes have already begun.

stories.title: Trump: “La Russia ha perso il controllo della sua industria del gasolio a causa della guerra”

en.title: Trump: "Russia has lost control of its diesel industry due to the war"
en.summary: Trump claims Russia has lost control of its diesel industry as a result of the war. According to the Financial Times, Moscow has recycled 6.9 billion dollars through international banks.

stories.title: Salvini, tetto ad alunni stranieri è bene spero Mattarella la pensi come me

en.title: Salvini, cap on foreign students is good, I hope Mattarella thinks like me
en.summary: Salvini expressed support for the cap on foreign students in schools. He also referenced opposition to the burqa as a historical position of his party.

stories.title: Salvini, al congresso della Lega conto e mi aspetto che si candidi qualcun altro

en.title: Salvini, at the League congress I am counting on and expect someone else to run
en.summary: Salvini stated his expectations for the League party congress. He reported receiving unanimous support from those present.

stories.title: Esplosione Calenzano, 6 dipendenti Eni chiedono patteggiare

en.title: Calenzano explosion, 6 Eni employees seek plea agreement
en.summary: Six employees involved in a workplace explosion are requesting plea deals. Three other individuals are facing referral to trial.

stories.title: Tragedia di Calenzano: sei indagati chiedono di patteggiare, tre verso il rinvio a giudizio

en.title: Calenzano tragedy: six defendants seek plea agreement, three face trial
en.summary: The Prato Public Prosecutor's Office supports six plea agreement requests. Three others are referred to trial. The explosion resulted in six deaths.

stories.title: Prof accoltellata, il ritorno in aula degli alunni. Il ragazzo congolese accolto come un eroe

en.title: Teacher stabbed, students return to class. Congolese boy welcomed as a hero
en.summary: Students returned to school following a stabbing incident involving a teacher. A red banner covered the school entrance as the community reflected on the event.

stories.title: Prof accoltellata, torna in classe il ragazzo che ha fermato l'aggressore: "Non sono un eroe"

en.title: Teacher stabbed, boy who stopped attacker returns to class: "I am not a hero"
en.summary: A 14-year-old of Congolese origin who intervened during a teacher's stabbing returned to school and downplayed his actions, though he was welcomed by the school community. Education ministry plans to invite him.

stories.title: Per destagionalizzare i gelati di Tonitto 1939 puntano sul Centro e Sud America

en.title: To diversify ice cream sales, Tonitto 1939 aims for Central and South America
en.summary: Tonitto 1939 ice cream and sorbet company is expanding exports to Central and South America, having already begun shipments to Peru with Mexico commercialization planned soon.

stories.title: Trento, alleanza ateneo-territorio per finanziare due progetti di ricerca

en.title: Trento, university-territory alliance to fund two research projects
en.summary: The University of Trento launched a crowdfunding campaign with a deadline of November 15 to finance two research projects through community participation.

stories.title: Grimaldi prende in consegna una nuova nave con tecnologie ecocompatibili

en.title: Grimaldi takes delivery of new ship with eco-friendly technologies
en.summary: Shipping company Grimaldi received the Grande Egitto, a new pure car and truck carrier vessel built by China Merchants Heavy Industries Jiangsu, expanding its fleet capacity.

stories.title: Fresenius Kabi inaugura la nuova linea, investimento da 28 milioni

en.title: Fresenius Kabi opens new production line with 28 million euro investment
en.summary: Pharmaceutical company Fresenius Kabi invested over 28 million euros in a new production line as part of a larger three-year Italian investment plan worth 100 million euros total.

stories.title: Ferrero, arriva il premio di risultato, 2.500 euro per i dipendenti italiani

en.title: Ferrero announces performance bonus of 2,500 euros for Italian employees
en.summary: Ferrero management and unions agreed on a performance-based bonus of 2,500 euros to be paid to Italian workers in October as established by company collective agreement.
